title: CRISPR screen links single-cell RNA-seq biomarkers to neuroinflammation
abstract: A CRISPR perturbation screen combines single-cell RNA-seq, Jupyter notebooks, and graph neural network models to identify biomarkers associated with neuroinflammation. The study cites 10.1038/s41586-020-03145-6 and maps genes to UniProt and MeSH terms.

title: NeuroCell Atlas v2 dataset
abstract: A versioned dataset containing normalized single-cell RNA-seq matrices, metadata, and quality-control notebooks for neuroinflammation cohorts. It is reused by CRISPR protocol experiments and stored with schema.org Dataset metadata.

title: Climate forecasting gap discovery notebook
abstract: A Jupyter and scikit-learn notebook identifies underexplored intersections between regional climate forecasting, materials degradation, and sensor placement. It cites 10.1126/science.abd1234 and exports FAIR metadata.

title: Protein folding reproducibility protocol
abstract: A Docker and Nextflow protocol standardizes protein folding benchmark execution, captures software versions, and links outputs to PubChem compounds and 10.1101/2025.01.08.123456.
